subject: Oceanography
title: Giant Squid
description: A quick, practical guide to Giant Squid.

hook.text: The giant squid eluded scientists for centuries—the first live footage wasn't captured until 2012.

buildup.text: Giant squid (Architeuthis) can reach 13 meters—and have the largest eyes in the animal kingdom at 27 cm.

discovery.text: Their massive eyes evolved to detect the faint bioluminescent glow of approaching sperm whales in the dark.

twist.text: Sucker scars on sperm whales prove epic battles in the deep—two giants fighting in total darkness.

climax.text: Despite their fame, almost everything about their life cycle remains unknown—they live in inaccessible depths.

punchline.text: The ocean's most famous monster is still its most mysterious.

quiz.question: When was the first live footage of a giant squid captured?
